title: The Spare Room — A1 opening cast and sound test

source.end_anchor: **RUTH:** I want it if I go.

effects.prompt: Close dry radio-drama foley in a quiet room: a fabric bag zipper opens, soft cloth shifts, then a ceramic mug is gently set on a wooden table. No voices, no music, no ambience.
Close subtle foley: a soft cloth rubs and polishes a pair of eyeglasses by hand. Quiet interior, no voices, no music.
Close dry foley: a wool coat is laid over the back of a wooden chair, one soft fabric rustle and a tiny chair creak. No voices, no music.
Very subtle close foley: one small sip of cold tea from a ceramic mug followed by a restrained swallow. No voice, no music, no ambience.
Close realistic foley: fresh tea is poured from a small teapot into a ceramic mug for one second. Quiet room, no voices, no music.
Close soft foley: a light fabric scarf is folded once and placed into an open cloth bag. Quiet interior, no voices, no music.

items.comment: [SOUND: A zip opens. Cloth, then a mug set on the table.]

items.speaker: RUTH
items.tags: [zipper opens] [cloth rustles] [ceramic mug set on a table] [sharp, controlled]

items.speaker: HELEN
items.text: There's hardly anything to take. Mum. Your arm.

items.speaker: NARRATOR
items.text: Helen holds a coat open behind Ruth's chair. Ruth reaches past the sleeve for her glasses. Kit has brought a swimming bag.

items.speaker: KIT
items.text: I can get a different bag.

items.speaker: HELEN
items.text: Please don't go and get anything else. We have everything.

items.comment: [PLAY: Ruth cleans her glasses. Helen continues holding the coat until the effort prompts her.]
[PLAY: Helen lays the coat over Ruth's chair.]

items.speaker: RUTH
items.tags: [a small sip from a mug] [watching her]
items.text: It's been there since this morning.

items.comment: [PLAY: Helen swallows. Kit laughs. Fresh tea is poured.]

items.speaker: RUTH
items.text: I was going to make some.

items.speaker: HELEN
items.text: I know. Kit, the light scarf. She wants that.

items.comment: [PLAY: Kit puts the scarf into the bag.]

items.speaker: RUTH
items.tags: [scarf fabric placed into an open bag] [correcting]
items.text: I want it if I go.
